_comment: Which of mxm-mono-00's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
The LFO 2 page and the fx.* roles were added to the standard for this instrument and are
DELIBERATELY ABSENT here: an instrument map naming a role a player's compiled-in standard
does not declare is refused WHOLE, so claiming them would cost every mapping below on any
player built before the roles existed. They are claimed once an unknown role is inert
rather than fatal - see docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md section 9.
filter.hpf is left unfilled: its curve metadata is not in the standard yet.
osc1.tune and osc2.tune are each oscillator's own coarse tune, so the two knobs change the
interval the ring modulator and sync turn into timbre. Master tune is off the map.
Every depth a role names is a route amount Init wires, so no role is a dead knob: the
filter's key track and the LFO's amplitude depth are the keyboard's route on the cutoff and
LFO 1's route on the tremolo. Three roles are left unfilled, deliberately. lfo1.to_pitch:
the plug-out's vibrato reached both oscillators, and one parameter cannot drive two routes -
pointing it at Oscillator 1 alone would turn vibrato into interval modulation. osc1/osc2
pwm_source: there is no source switch, the source is chosen on the card. osc1/osc2 pwm_depth:
Init routes nothing to a pulse width, as MANUAL routed nothing, so a depth would be dead.
